title: Part Nine: Peter Thiel: the Life

sections.brief: Frankfurt 1967; Cleveland; South West Africa and South Africa 1971-77 (Pridwin, Swakopmund; father's mine job as setting, not record); Foster City; Stanford, Girard, the Stanford Review 1987; apartheid recollections (Lythcott-Haims, Maxwell, Chafkin) vs spokesperson denial; The Diversity Myth with Sacks and the 2016 regret; JD 1992, Edmondson clerkship, Sullivan & Cromwell, Credit Suisse, Bennett; Thiel Capital; Fieldlink 1998. Figures: compare, time

Fieldlink/Confinity, Roth purchase 1999, X.com merger and Sept 2000 board change, IPO and eBay $1.5bn (3.7%, ~$55M); Clarium rise and fall; Palantir 2003 (~$30M mostly Thiel, In-Q-Tel ~$2M); Facebook $500k for 10.2% and >$1bn sales; Founders Fund (SpaceX, Anduril as fund positions), Valar 2010 (Epstein LP, link de14), Mithril 2012, Thiel Fellowship and Tlon; fund vs personal holdings. Figures: time, money

Valleywag 2007, 'Al Qaeda' 2009, secret ~$10M funding, $140M verdict, bankruptcy, Gawker.com closure, $31M settlement, 'specific deterrence', Aug 2016 op-ed; NZ citizenship 2011 (12 days, exceptional circumstances, Christchurch donation, revealed 2017); German citizenship per 2011 file; Malta reported 2022; Roth IRA $1,700 to ~$5bn (ProPublica), legality disputed, audit closed. Figures: flow, compare

Cato 2009 and clarification; seasteading ($500k; $1.25M vs $1.7M); RNC speech, $1.25M, transition 2016; 2020 Kobach; Vance intro 2021, Meta exit 2022, Vance and Masters super PACs (CNBC FEC vs Ballotpedia/Forbes figures); 2023-24 pledge (Reuters, Gellman paraphrase, Aspen) vs >$1.7M unitemised; 2025-26 giving, California tax fight, Florida; Milei meetings, house, NYT citizenship report and denial, move to Buenos Aires, Argentine Congress hearing; Antichrist lectures (link de10).
